verdict.rationale: Runloop offers Snapshots to save Devbox disk state and export/re-create Devboxes, and Dockerfile-based blueprints imply portability of environments, but there is no documented feature for exporting all account/user data (benchmarks, configs, agent history) in open formats or a clear data-export/account-deletion workflow. missing for 10: explicit full account data export tool, open-format guarantees for all data types, data portability/deletion documentation.
